transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I don't feel safe and I'm incredibly anxious. I know that a certain organization has been watching and monitoring me everywhere I go, and it's been happening for about ten months now.
During these ten months, have you also had times of feeling very depressed or, on the other hand, unusually energized, needing much less sleep, or feeling abnormally confident or irritable?
No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme highs and lows. I don't ever feel unusually energized or deeply depressed. To be honest, my mood has just felt very flat and empty lately.
Have you heard voices, seen things other people don’t, or noticed your thoughts becoming hard to follow or your speech feeling disorganized?

No, I don't hear or see things that aren't there. But my thoughts have been really jumbled lately, and I constantly lose my train of thought. People often tell me it's hard to follow what I'm saying because I drift off to other topics.
Have these symptoms made it harder for you to work, study, take care of yourself, or maintain relationships compared with before?

Yes, my daily life has been severely affected for about nine months now. I've completely lost the motivation to do my work or even take care of basic things like feeding myself or cleaning. I've also stopped talking to my friends and family and just isolate myself in my room.
Have there ever been periods when your mood symptoms were clearly present for most of the time while the paranoia or disorganized thinking continued even when your mood was back to normal?

I don't think so, because I haven't really had any major mood shifts at all. My mood has just been flat this whole time, so there weren't any periods of depression or high energy while the monitoring was happening.

There are no clear manic or depressive episodes to suggest schizoaffective disorder or bipolar disorder, and no hallucinations are required for schizophrenia if other core psychotic symptoms are present. The candidate list remains unchanged.
